name: Gem Dragonborn

traits.name: Psionic Mind
traits.description: You can communicate a telepathic message to one creature you can see within 30 feet. It understands the message if it understands at least one language, whether or not you share a language. This sends a message only: it does not read thoughts or grant the recipient a telepathic reply.

traits.name: Gem Flight
traits.description: Starting at character level 5, you can use a Bonus Action on your turn to manifest spectral wings for 1 minute. While they last, you gain a flying speed equal to your current walking speed and can hover. You can use this trait once per Long Rest; it is independent of your Breath Weapon.

reviewNotes: Nonselectable Gem family; select an ordinary Amethyst, Crystal, Emerald, Sapphire or Topaz leaf.

Inherit base Dragonborn Dragon type, Low-Light Vision, movement, 50% resistance to the leaf's damage type and the ordinary Breath Weapon with proficiency-bonus uses per Long Rest. This family supplies its 15-foot cone area.
Psionic Mind only sends messages to a visible language-understanding recipient; it grants no learned language, mind reading or two-way telepathy.
Gem Flight is a separate once-per-Long-Rest level-5 feature, granting temporary hovering flight at current walking speed rather than permanent flight.
The five ordinary leaf identities configure separate affinities; they do not require additional invented innate adaptations or selected Upbringings.

Source basis: Fizban's Treasury of Dragons (2021), Gem Dragonborn, adapted to the native Dorks & Dice Dragon-type and percentage resistance system. Exceptional Ruby remains a separate nonstandard design.
